checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No additional mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead is described as added to arrangements.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is also on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the disclosure only notes embalming may be necessary with viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the Direct Cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is also on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation options include purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and unfinished wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation includesText lists transportation to crematory and cremation with no separate crematory cash advance shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or policy.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claims about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appear.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and disclosures appear in clear prescribed form.
